column1: #mapping_set_description: Hub 'genome' stanzas, from genomes.txt or from a useOneFile hub.txt; one record per genome. This is where an assembly hub declares its sequence, sizes, alias files and naming authority.

column9: Lossy: GenArk includes the strain (Saccharomyces cerevisiae S288C).
Which names the browser displays. In GenArk the 2bit uses RefSeq names and chromAuthority ucsc only changes the display, so it is not the collection's naming authority.
GenArk writes '<asmName> <date>' (R64 Dec. 2014) here, not an organism.
Genetic code per sequence; no core field.
Per-target liftOver chain files (key pattern liftOver.<target>); relations between assemblies by alignment, not seqcol relations.
